Definition: properly, a split, i.e. a wide level valley between mountains
BiblicalUsage: A valley is a wide, level place between mountains, and the word runs through the whole story. In Genesis 11:2 men journeying from the east found a plain in the land of Shinar and dwelt there, building Babel. In Deuteronomy 8:7 God promises a good land, with valleys and hills. In Isaiah 40:4 every valley shall be exalted, and in Ezekiel 37:1 the Lord sets the prophet down in the midst of a valley full of dry bones.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the valley in Ezekiel is the promise for every valley: God sets his prophet down in the middle of the dry bones, and the bones live.
